result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical data/content bug showing 'NaN' delivery price, and a minor layout issue with a card being cut off at the screen edge.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of an actual delivery fee, indicating a calculation or data-binding error.
issues.suggestion: Fix the logic that computes delivery fee to handle missing or invalid values, and display a fallback like 'Free' or a valid price instead of NaN.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only partial content.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll padding/margins so the last visible card is either fully shown or clearly indicates scrollability with a partial peek intentionally styled.
